cards.gloss_en: solemn promises made to god or oneself
cards.ex_en: He made two vows before the trip.
cards.ex_cn: 他在旅行前立下两个誓言。

cards.gloss_en: remarks that express an opinion or judgement
cards.ex_en: Her observations about life were wise.
cards.ex_cn: 她对人生的见解很有智慧。

cards.gloss_en: made used to something hard or unpleasant
cards.ex_en: The sailors were inured to cold nights.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们已习惯了寒冷的夜晚。

cards.gloss_en: assure or promise something confidently
cards.ex_en: I warrant you will pass the test.
cards.ex_cn: 我敢保证你会通过考试。

cards.gloss_en: heavy metal devices that hold a ship in place
cards.ex_en: The ship dropped two anchors in the bay.
cards.ex_cn: 船在海湾里抛下两只锚。

cards.gloss_en: changed direction suddenly
cards.ex_en: The wind veered to the north.
cards.ex_cn: 风向转到了北方。

cards.gloss_en: watchful and alert to danger
cards.ex_en: The guard stayed vigilant all night.
cards.ex_cn: 卫兵整夜保持警觉。

cards.gloss_en: the cheap lower deck area of a ship
cards.ex_en: The poor passengers slept in the steerage.
cards.ex_cn: 穷苦的乘客睡在统舱里。

cards.gloss_en: moving heavily and with great difficulty
cards.ex_en: The boat was labouring in the rough sea.
cards.ex_cn: 小船在怒海中费力地颠簸。

cards.gloss_en: a sail set on a spar across the mast
cards.ex_en: They raised the spritsail to catch the wind.
cards.ex_cn: 他们升起斜杠帆去兜风。

cards.gloss_en: firm, deeply held beliefs
cards.ex_en: His convictions of guilt kept him awake.
cards.ex_cn: 内心确信的罪责让他无法入睡。

cards.gloss_en: developed a crack that lets water through
cards.ex_en: The old barrel had sprung a leak.
cards.ex_cn: 那只旧桶裂开漏了水。

cards.gloss_en: a floating marker on the water
cards.ex_en: A red buoy marked the safe channel.
cards.ex_cn: 一个红色浮标标出了安全航道。

cards.gloss_en: slanting up or down at an angle
cards.ex_en: We walked up the sloping path.
cards.ex_cn: 我们沿着倾斜的小路往上走。

cards.gloss_en: rising up or climbing higher
cards.ex_en: The boat was mounting a huge wave.
cards.ex_cn: 小船正涌上一道巨浪。

cards.gloss_en: a young cow
cards.ex_en: The calf followed its mother across the field.
cards.ex_cn: 小牛跟着母牛穿过田野。

cards.gloss_en: dominating and controlling everything
cards.ex_en: An overruling fate seemed to guide him.
cards.ex_cn: 一种支配一切的命运似乎在引导他。

cards.gloss_en: a brief outburst or wandering of feeling
cards.ex_en: That angry speech was just an excursion of his temper.
cards.ex_cn: 那番怒言只是他一时的情绪发作。

cards.gloss_en: by using force
cards.ex_en: They forcibly pushed the door open.
cards.ex_cn: 他们强行把门推开。

cards.gloss_en: leaving something out
cards.ex_en: He told the story, omitting the sad part.
cards.ex_cn: 他讲了这个故事,略去了伤心的部分。

cards.gloss_en: necessary
cards.ex_en: She packed everything needful for the journey.
cards.ex_cn: 她把旅途必要的东西都装好了。

cards.gloss_en: a tropical fever caused by great heat
cards.ex_en: The heat gave the sailor a calenture.
cards.ex_cn: 酷热让那水手染上了热带热病。

cards.gloss_en: a pirate ship
cards.ex_en: A rover chased the merchant ship at dawn.
cards.ex_cn: 一艘海盗船在黎明追赶那商船。

cards.gloss_en: damaged so it can no longer work
cards.ex_en: The storm disabled the ship's rudder.
cards.ex_cn: 风暴使船的舵失灵了。

cards.gloss_en: feared or expected with worry
cards.ex_en: He apprehended danger on the dark road.
cards.ex_cn: 他担心黑暗的路上有危险。

cards.gloss_en: a small light boat
cards.ex_en: They rowed the pinnace back to the ship.
cards.ex_cn: 他们划着小艇回到大船。

cards.gloss_en: pull something heavy with effort
cards.ex_en: The men hauled the net onto the deck.
cards.ex_cn: 船员们把渔网拖上甲板。

cards.gloss_en: swung the sail across to the other side
cards.ex_en: The sail jibed as the wind shifted.
cards.ex_cn: 风向一变,帆桁便转了向。

cards.gloss_en: small storage chests or compartments
cards.ex_en: He kept his tools in two small lockers.
cards.ex_cn: 他把工具放在两个小储物箱里。

cards.gloss_en: provide room or supplies for someone
cards.ex_en: The boat could accommodate six men.
cards.ex_cn: 这条船能容纳六个人。

cards.gloss_en: eat the evening meal
cards.ex_en: They would sup together after the work.
cards.ex_cn: 干完活后他们会一起吃晚饭。

cards.gloss_en: a false reason given to hide the truth
cards.ex_en: He left on the pretence of being ill.
cards.ex_cn: 他借口生病而离开。

cards.gloss_en: a hard dry piece of baked bread
cards.ex_en: The sailors ate rusk and dried fish.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们吃着硬面包干和鱼干。

cards.gloss_en: clearly seen or easily understood
cards.ex_en: It was evident that he was tired.
cards.ex_cn: 很明显他累了。

cards.gloss_en: strong thin string or cord
cards.ex_en: She tied the parcel with strong twine.
cards.ex_cn: 她用结实的细绳捆好包裹。

cards.gloss_en: toward the direction the wind blows from
cards.ex_en: The boat sailed windward to escape.
cards.ex_cn: 小船朝上风处驶去以求脱身。

cards.gloss_en: talking with others
cards.ex_en: They spent the evening conversing quietly.
cards.ex_cn: 他们整晚静静地交谈。

cards.gloss_en: a unit of liquid measure
cards.ex_en: There was not a pint of water left.
cards.ex_cn: 连一品脱水都不剩了。

cards.gloss_en: walked about with no fixed aim
cards.ex_en: The boy rambled along the riverbank.
cards.ex_cn: 男孩沿着河岸漫步。

cards.gloss_en: large spotted wild cats
cards.ex_en: Two leopards hid in the tall grass.
cards.ex_cn: 两只豹藏在高草丛里。

cards.gloss_en: the open front end of a gun barrel
cards.ex_en: He pointed the muzzle at the sky.
cards.ex_cn: 他把枪口对着天空。

cards.gloss_en: wild animals hunted for food or sport
cards.ex_en: The hunters brought home plenty of game.
cards.ex_cn: 猎人们带回了许多猎物。

cards.gloss_en: measured loads of powder and shot
cards.ex_en: He wasted three charges of powder.
cards.ex_cn: 他白白浪费了三份火药。

cards.gloss_en: a long spear used as a weapon
cards.ex_en: The rider carried a long lance.
cards.ex_cn: 骑手拿着一支长长的矛。

suspect.ctx: ...we thought once or twice our anchor had come home; ... so that we rode with two anchors ahead, and the cables veered out to the bitter end.
suspect.issue: 此处是航海术语,宾语是锚缆(cables veered out),意为把缆绳松放到底,而非船/风改变方向;回读'转向,改变方向'放不进'把缆放尽'的语境
suspect.suggest: 增/改为'松出、放长(缆绳)'义

suspect.ctx: ...that impressed those conceits so forcibly upon me as to make me deaf to all good advice...
suspect.issue: 此处 forcibly 修饰念头被'强烈/有力地'烙印在心上,不是'以武力强制去做';'强行地'含违背意愿用武力之意,回读不贴
suspect.suggest: 增/改为'强烈地、有力地(打动/铭刻)'义

suspect.ctx: ...the devil generally not omitting to lay some snare for them very early...
suspect.issue: omit to do 意为'疏于、忘记去做某事';'not omitting to lay a snare'=总不忘设下陷阱。'省略'指有意略去内容,与'疏于做某事'的用法不完全对应
suspect.suggest: 补'疏于、忘记(去做)'一义(omit to do)
